summary.text: Chen Cheng is called the Sincerity Immortal, a Northern Plains lone Gu Immortal who cultivates rule path and is challenged at Sincerity grassland.

claims.text: At Sincerity grassland he stands before a masked female immortal who names herself Fairy Black Moon. She calls him the Sincerity Immortal who cultivates rule path, and she produces a token tied to an old agreement he made as a Gu Master: the loser would recognize the winner as owner and assist them. He confirms the token is real, warns that he is a lone cultivator with many trump cards after years roaming Northern Plains, and agrees that if she wins he will acknowledge her as master, while if she loses he will be her master. She praises that everyone calls him someone who keeps his words and promises, and the two immortals begin to fight.
He is dressed in green, arms crossed behind his back, standing arrogantly upright.

He tells Wooden Statue Lord Wu Guang that he lost to his master and became her servant according to their agreement. In green robes he appears after Fairy Black Moon kills an ancient desolate ginseng that nearly finished Wu Guang, waves off credit for the rescue, and names his master as the one who saved Wu Guang’s life. He explains that she came out of seclusion to challenge experts, and that Wu Guang’s close relationship with Yin Wu Que can lead them to Crescent Moon Mound.
With Wooden Statue Lord Wu Guang he watches Fairy Black Moon’s fight against Yin Wu Que, eyelids twitching as punches land.

After Yin Wu Que admits defeat she asks him who the next opponent is. When Liu Chang and Liu Luo arrive, he and Wu Guang look at each other and stay silent. He moves to mediate when the Liu siblings press Fairy Black Moon, then watches dumbfounded as she thrashes them, and later lets out a held breath once they escape. He feels a headache at her ambition to challenge Huang Jin super tribes after defeating lone and demonic immortals.

Narration notes that Fairy Black Moon defeated him and Yin Wu Que while challenging experts. Among spectators of her public fight with Liu Chang he stands with Wu Guang and Yin Wu Que, frowns when bedazzlement restricts investigative methods, and sighs in relief after her victory that her reputation will rise even higher.

Watching Fairy Black Moon fight Chu Du, he and Yin Wu Que wear grim expressions as Chu Du’s combat experience suppresses her, and he gasps aloud when Chu Du closes the gap while she prepares a killer move.

When Wu Guang thinks Chu Du is admitting defeat, he says something is not right and that his master seems to be in a weird state. After Chu Du wins yet saves her from backlash, he is named among those who supported Fairy Black Moon and still secretly feel admiration toward Chu Du.
